input_kind: Independent simulated rewalk (U6, U8, U12); synthetic phone/laptop screenshots, current templates and polling code, saved manual logs. Tablet layout and downloaded PDF content were not directly inspected; predicted user effects are hypotheses.

checks.step: Mistake: interpret completed/100 percent as verified content.
checks.result: Addressed in the observed status UI. Hypothesis: Noor can distinguish compilation and availability from verification.
checks.evidence: after-status-phone.png and after-status-laptop.png show PDF compiled, availability rather than a quality score, and Successful compilation does not verify requirements, code behavior or test results. job.html places these statements beside progress and downloads.

checks.step: Mistake: assume browser-session privacy means local-only processing.
checks.result: Addressed explicitly, with a remaining prominence concern.
checks.evidence: after-phone.png shows files uploaded to and processed on this server, provider disclosure, cookie-access consequences, and Server-stored documents in the footer. index.html contains the same disclosure.

checks.step: Mistake: follow unavailable retry advice after an outline result.
checks.result: The observed copy now makes provider availability a condition and supplies manual review as an immediate path. Destination execution was not tested in this rewalk.
checks.evidence: after-status-phone.png shows Review sections and TODOs plus With a working connected provider before Continue unfinished sections. job.html conditionally displays the continuation link when baseline sections exist.

checks.step: Observe a failed status refresh and recover.
checks.result: Addressed in the supplied fixture; no implication that processing stopped.
checks.evidence: after-poll-phone.png shows last known state and Refresh status. job.ts exposes a retry button, retains state, and resumes polling. poll.log records stale notice visible followed by recovery to 4 of 4 available and 1 model-improved.

checks.step: Invariant: no-key outline remains honest; saved edits/tables remain; private processing is not described as local.
checks.result: Supported by screenshots, code and supplied manual evidence; not an independent persistence or PDF-content test.
checks.evidence: walk.log reports outcome outline, baseline 4, model 0, unresolved 4; status screenshot labels Outline PDF. sections.html displays preserved tables and storage/sections.go changes section.Body without clearing tables. edits.log records stored tables, other unsaved edit preservation, navigation guard and retained text after error. after-phone.png explicitly states server processing.

remaining.problem: Simulated hypothesis: when skimming the privacy claim before choosing source files, Noor encounters Private access tied to this browser near the top, but the explicit server/provider disclosure appears below Create document. The disclosure is accurate yet easy to miss before acting.
remaining.suggestion: Place a short server-processing disclosure beside the source input or the top privacy claim, keeping the existing detailed notice.
